export_arguments.export_copyright: Original harbor geometry, materials and analytical sky: CC0-1.0; https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

validated: exported water welded manifold, paired opposite edges and positive signed volume

known_caveats: Reference-composed original scene, not a pixel-exact reconstruction.
Windows are opaque reflective glazing, not additional dielectric volumes.
Water is the only closed dielectric; opaque bed, quay and hull geometry may be underwater.
Nearest/linear base-level texture sampling is sufficient; no texture mip payloads are exported.
Fixture binaries were preserved, not regenerated; original fixture sky is scenes/fixtures/sky.hdr.
Blender mesh buffer re-exports are not promised byte-stable; pin delivered artifact hashes.
No sun disk in the environment; illumination uses one directional sun plus weak inn point light and emissive lanterns.

name: The Cream Sail Harbor
post_export_steps: Set core glTF sampler minFilter to base-level nearest/linear, retaining all binary geometry/images unchanged. No absent mipmap hierarchy is requested.

final_render.note: Original CPU path-traced output, not a Blender render or a reference-image composite. Some Monte Carlo grain remains; no denoiser is applied.

reference_policy: Visual guidance only. No reference pixels are read, sampled, copied, hashed or used as a texture/background by these sources.

check_existing.description: Check and warn on overwriting existing files

export_active_vertex_color_when_no_mater.description: When there is no material on object, export active vertex color

export_all_vertex_colors.description: Export all vertex colors, even if not used by any material. If no Vertex Color is used in the mesh materials, a fake COLOR_0 will be created, in order to keep material unchanged

export_animations.description: Exports active actions and NLA tracks as glTF animations

export_apply.description: Apply modifiers (excluding Armatures) to mesh objects -WARNING: prevents exporting shape keys

export_copyright.description: Legal rights and conditions for the model

export_extras.description: Export custom properties as glTF extras

export_format.verified_via: installed get_format_items callback and two actual exports

export_gpu_instances.description: Export using EXT_mesh_gpu_instancing. Limited to children of a given Empty. Multiple materials might be omitted

export_hierarchy_flatten_objs.description: Flatten Object Hierarchy. Useful in case of non decomposable transformation matrix

export_hierarchy_full_collections.description: Export full hierarchy, including intermediate collections

export_image_add_webp.description: Creates WebP textures for every texture. For already WebP textures, nothing happens

export_image_format.description: Output format for images. PNG is lossless and generally preferred, but JPEG might be preferable for web applications due to the smaller file size. Alternatively they can be omitted if they are not needed

export_image_webp_fallback.description: For all WebP textures, create a PNG fallback texture

export_import_convert_lighting_mode.description: Optional backwards compatibility for non-standard render engines. Applies to lights

export_keep_originals.description: Keep original textures files if possible. WARNING: if you use more than one texture, where pbr standard requires only one, only one texture will be used. This can lead to unexpected results

export_lights.description: Export directional, point, and spot lights. Uses "KHR_lights_punctual" glTF extension

export_pointer_animation.description: Export material, Light & Camera animation as Animation Pointer. Available only for baked animation mode 'NLA Tracks' and 'Scene'

export_texture_dir.description: Folder to place texture files in. Relative to the .gltf file

export_unused_images.description: Export images not assigned to any material

export_unused_textures.description: Export image texture nodes not assigned to any material. This feature is not standard and needs an external extension to be included in the glTF file

export_use_gltfpack.description: Use gltfpack to simplify the mesh and/or compress its textures

use_mesh_edges.description: Export loose edges as lines, using the material from the first material slot

use_mesh_vertices.description: Export loose points as glTF points, using the material from the first material slot

will_save_settings.description: Store glTF export settings in the Blender project
